HANFORD_AEC_PLANT.reason: Primary scan is identified but official-federal-host byte/page bind remains incomplete; preserve blindness for a future holdout.

OFFUTT_AFB.reason: Direct Project Blue Book case-byte/page bind not closed before Earth freeze; preserve blindness for a future holdout.

interpretation.1: plus or minus one UTC calendar day
interpretation.3: plus or minus three UTC calendar days

primary_statistics.T_r: number of frozen R4.2 site-dates whose radius-r window contains at least one materialized Palomar observation-day row
primary_statistics.S_r: number of frozen R4.2 sites with at least one radius-r event-date hit
primary_statistics.U_r: number of unique materialized Palomar observation days in the union of all R4.2 event windows; descriptive only

primary_null.name: INDEPENDENT_SITE_CLUSTER_RIGID_TRANSLATION_EXHAUSTIVE
primary_null.description: Translate every site's entire frozen date cluster by an independent integer number of days. Preserve all within-site date separations exactly. Retain only translations whose full plus/minus-three-day support stays inside the Palomar study window. Compute exact per-site hit histograms and combine them by integer-count convolution; do not Monte Carlo sample.
preserves: number of event dates per site

seasonality_sensitivity_null.name: INDEPENDENT_SITE_CLUSTER_CALENDAR_YEAR_SHIFT_EXHAUSTIVE
seasonality_sensitivity_null.description: Translate each site's full date cluster only by independent whole-calendar-year offsets, preserving month/day and within-site clustering. Include every year offset for which the full plus/minus-three-day support remains inside the study window. Combine exact per-site count distributions by convolution.
seasonality_sensitivity_null.purpose: Sensitivity check against Palomar seasonality and calendar-month observation-density structure.

multiple_window_and_candidate_gate.law: DO NOT OPEN PLATE CANDIDATES BECAUSE A DATE LOOKS PRETTY. TEMPORAL EXCESS MUST FIRST SURVIVE BOTH NULL FAMILIES AND THE FROZEN MULTIPLE-WINDOW GATE.

interpretation_contract.hit: A hit means only that the POSS-I materialized ledger contains at least one Palomar observation opportunity inside the preregistered Earth-date window.
interpretation_contract.miss: A miss means no materialized Palomar observation-day row fell inside that window. It does not mean the sky was observed and empty.
interpretation_contract.significance: A small null-tail fraction would establish only unusual temporal observation-opportunity coincidence under the frozen calendar nulls, not physical identity or causation.
forbidden_promotions: candidate-level anomaly claim before the frozen gate passes

claim_ceiling: R4.2 MAY TEST ONLY WHETHER AN INDEPENDENT THIRD SOURCE-FIRST EARTH HOLDOUT HAS MORE PALOMAR OBSERVATION-OPPORTUNITY OVERLAP THAN EXPECTED UNDER THE PREREGISTERED NULLS.
canonical_seal: FREEZE EARTH, FREEZE THE NULLS, THEN OPEN THE PALOMAR CALENDAR. HANFORD AND OFFUTT STAY CLOSED. PRETTY COINCIDENCES DO NOT BYPASS THE GATE.
